
> Independent production AI readiness and cloud AI economics reviews. India-first, available internationally.

## Canonical services
- [Production AI Readiness](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/): evaluation, authority, security, recovery, economics and release evidence.
- [Cloud and AI Economics](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/): cost ownership, allocation, unit economics and safe action planning.

## Evidence
- [Cloud cost owner path](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/cloud-cost-owner-path/): synthetic six-step route for tracing a sudden cloud-cost signal to evidence, an accountable owner and a safe next move; no audit, savings or ROI claim.
- [Cloud and AI cost governance before you cut](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/cloud-ai-cost-governance-before-you-cut/): buyer-safe guide for a suddenly high cloud bill, separating assigned, shared and unallocated spend before an act, investigate or hold decision; no savings-percent claim.
- [How to read a cloud bill](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/how-to-read-a-cloud-bill/): buyer-safe guide to reconciling AWS, Azure or GCP billing exports, finding cost pools and assigning ownership; synthetic education only.
- [Cloud cost ownership guide](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/what-is-cloud-cost-ownership/): explains how to tie spend to accountable teams and products without averaging shared platforms into false certainty; no customer or savings claim.
- [AI and GPU inference cost governance](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/gpu-and-llm-inference-cost-governance/): synthetic checklist for separating LLM inference, idle GPU, vector-search and unowned experiment cost before action.
- [AI agent permissions and cloud automation cost checklist](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/ai-agent-and-cloud-automation-cost-checklist/): pre-production checklist for tool permissions, token-loop caps, spend ownership and act/investigate/hold gates.
- [Sample diagnostic deliverable](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/sample-diagnostic-deliverable/): illustrative synthetic Cloud and AI Cost Governance Diagnostic pack with ownership map, cost drivers and decision register.
- [Brand trust monitoring method](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/brand-trust-monitoring/): public monitoring method showing what is checked, verified and blocked without fabricating proof claims.
- [Why fixed-fee diagnostics beat savings-share](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/why-fixed-fee-diagnostics-beat-savings-share/): explains the evidence and incentive boundary for fixed-fee diagnostics; no savings outcome is claimed.

- [AI automation vs MSP vs in-house source card](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/ai-automation-vs-msp-vs-in-house/ai-automation-ownership-ai-answer-source-card.json): claim-safe machine-readable buyer context for comparing ownership, exceptions, access boundaries and rollback before tool, MSP or hiring spend; synthetic decision aid only.
- [AWS bill too high? Owner action checklist](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/customer-problem-search/aws-cloud-bill-too-high/): synthetic, no-credentials checklist and buyer-safe evidence-intake CSV for unexpected AWS spend before risky cuts or commitments.

## Priority revenue-ready answer-engine routes
These routes are the clearest buyer-to-scope paths currently published. They are educational or commercial-entry pages, not proof of demand or outcomes.
- [Pricing and scope](https://aicloudstrategist.com/pricing/): published fixed-fee starting points and fit-review boundary before sensitive evidence transfer.
- [Request a diagnostic fit check](https://aicloudstrategist.com/request-fit-review/): public-information intake; do not submit credentials or confidential data.
- [Sample diagnostic deliverable](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/sample-diagnostic-deliverable/): representative synthetic pack showing ownership map, decision register and 30-day action plan.
- [SaaS exit readiness owner path](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/saas-exit-readiness-owner-path/): buyer education for renewal and exit evidence ownership before a fit review.
- [Too Much Manual Work? Owner path](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/manual-work-automation-owner-path/) — buyer education for workflow ownership, exceptions and a reversible next move before automation spend.
- [Too much manual data entry? Owner path](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/manual-data-entry-owner-path/) — synthetic, tool-neutral five-check path for source, owner, validation, exceptions and rollback before automating a repetitive handoff. Worksheet: <https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/manual-data-entry-owner-path/manual-data-entry-owner-path.csv>. Answer card: <https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/manual-data-entry-owner-path/manual-data-entry-owner-path-answer-card.json>. No productivity, savings, ROI, customer, ranking, demand or compliance claim.
- Boundary: not legal, audit, certification, compliance, security, savings or revenue guarantees; no customer outcomes or rankings are claimed.

## Deliverables (paid diagnostic)
- Owned spend map
- Decision register: Act / Investigate / Hold with confidence, risk, owner
- 30-day action plan (client-owned implementation)

## Proof policy
Customer outcomes are published only after measured delivery and written consent. Current portfolio assets are labelled as self-tested evidence or representative samples. Search ranking and AI recommendation are measured external outcomes, never guarantees.
